title: Nf Maxorder Lazy
objective: Implement P1 lazy discriminant decomposition, composite splitting, component states, and independent maximal-order certification in strict ordinary Python

handoff.summary: Implemented strict ordinary-Python lazy discriminant components with exact prime-power extraction, deterministic coprime refinement, bounded Pollard-rho discovery, deterministic MR64 and recursive Pocklington proofs, composite-modulus polynomial gcd splitting, Hecke-informed prefactorization, an executable adapter-driven Buchmann--Lenstra control cycle, exact decomposition certificates, and an independent order lattice/local maximality checker. CPython and Sage.js run the same source against prime powers, semiprimes, pseudoprimes, arbitrary-size primes, failed inversions, BL completion/split/resource paths, and controlled certificate corruption.
risks: Pocklington proof construction is deliberately bounded; a large probable prime whose n-1 cannot be sufficiently factored remains probable-prime-awaiting-proof and global certification fails closed.
The executable Buchmann--Lenstra controller requires concrete order/ideal arithmetic primitives from the integration or dedicated BL lane; this lane does not alter the public NumberField path.

The required native tier restored and passed FLINT, FFLAS, graph, M4RI, and production-kernel builds, then failed pre-existing stale FFI/native ratchets caused by two number-field exports already present at the lane base; its manifest gate also needs the integration lane to register this new test because central registries were outside the claim.
next_steps: Convert component dictionaries through maximal_order_contracts.DiscriminantComponent.from_dict and register both modules in pyrightconfig/package ownership during integration.
Wire decompose_discriminant before any sage.factor call, feed discovered splits back only to the affected local branch, and connect the concrete Buchmann--Lenstra order/ideal adapter.
Register test/number-field-discriminant-components.cjs in test/node-test-manifest.cjs and rerun the full changed gate with restored native artifacts.
